summary: Iteration 16 — Org Chart templates (reporting/functional/location/project + invalid 400), Employees PATCH (cycle/self-management protection, whitelist, denormalize), Projects CRUD, Branches PUT/DELETE (HQ singleton, in_use guard), Employees list filters (branch/dept/type/q). 17/17 backend pytests pass. Frontend smoke on /app/org-chart (4 template buttons render, all 4 switch without errors, 42 org nodes, edit dialog opens), /app/employees, /app/branches (state dropdown, country, pincode, HQ checkbox, save all visible). No critical bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: org_routes.chart() — for project template, members are added to roots without a children:[] reset; reused emp_to_card cards may already be referenced in other groups (e.g. same employee in 2 projects). Mutating .children on shared dict references can corrupt later groups. Recommend deep-copying card() per group or constructing fresh cards inside the project loop.

org_routes.update_branch — when is_head_office=true and the branch_id itself doesn't exist in this company, the unset of other branches still runs first; minor — but should re-order: validate branch existence before clearing other HQs (atomicity).

Branches.jsx — the new-branch flow does POST then re-GETs the full list to find the just-created branch by name+country_id match (line 57). Race-prone; backend POST should accept and persist state_code/pincode/phone/is_head_office in one shot, or POST should return the doc so client can use returned id directly (it actually does return doc — code should just use response data rather than re-querying).

employees_routes.patch_employee — cycle check walks up via manager_id chain but does NOT cap iteration count (depends on `seen`). With corrupted data (manager_id pointing to deleted employee) the loop exits when find_one returns None, OK. But missing project_ids type validation — passing project_ids: 'foo' (string) would break MongoDB array semantics. Add isinstance check.

OrgChart.jsx flattenTree — collapsed state ignores depth-based parent collapse (comment notes 'rely on user toggling each level'). Functional but UX gap — collapsing a parent leaves descendants visible. Consider tracking subtree visibility via collapsed-set instead of per-node.
Branches.jsx — country select only shown on create; editing cannot move a branch to a different country. Acceptable but document the limitation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (org-chart 4 templates + edit dialog, employees, branches admin all rendered without runtime errors)
